parameters.content:
## NetEase Cloud Music Song, Chart & Playlist Scraper

**Actor:** [NetEase Cloud Music Song, Chart & Playlist Scraper](https://apify.com/dataspryva/netease-cloud-music-song-chart-and-playlist)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/netease-cloud-music-song-chart-and-playlist-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `searchType` (string)
- `songUrls` (array)
- `artistIds` (array)
- `artistOrder` (string)
- `albumUrls` (array)
- `playlistUrls` (array)
- `playlistCat` (string)
- `toplistIds` (array)
- `maxTracksPerChart` (integer)
- `commentUrls` (array)

### Output fields
- `name` (Name)
- `artist` (Artist)
- `album` (Album)
- `rankPosition` (Rank Position)
- `chartName` (Chart Name)
- `playlistName` (Playlist Name)
- `durationSec` (Duration Sec)

description: NetEase Cloud Music song, chart scraper: runs the NetEase Cloud Music Song, Chart & Playlist Scraper Apify Actor, returns name, artist, album, rankPosition, playlistName and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
